triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.note: Binds the user acceptance claim to the evidence-activated apply path, non-authoritative audit row, runtime consumption, idempotency, demotion recommendation, and negative controls for DONE-only/missing evidence/default-off flag regression.

note: B-7ee1 ProofStory contract: the acceptance claim is satisfied only by evidence-qualified advisory activation plus negative controls; learning remains non-authoritative and cannot satisfy gates.
